success.description: 4 You transmute the target item into lead. The exact details of such a transmutation can vary, but in general it doubles the item's encumbrance value, reduces quality to poor. It reduces a weapon's DR by 1 or Soak and Defence by 1 each. It also makes the item much more malleable and prone to damage.

boon.description: You can transmute the item back to its original material as a manoeuvre.

conservative.requirements: SPELLCRAFT (INT) Vs. SPECIAL S power, target metal item within close range. Special: The difficulty of this task is either set by the GM based on the size, craftsmanship, and durability of the item, or the check is opposed by the Discipline (WP) of the creature carrying or wearing the object.
conservative.name: Transmutation of Lead
